provenance.method: First contact of each deterministic parcel trajectory against the moving conservative chamber heightfield and valve exclusions. No re-emission after contact. Offline finite-step detection with bisection; not wall-film or spray-breakup physics.

assumptions.scope: Reduced ballistic drag and D-squared evaporation illustration. Assumed 8-hole spray at recovered source tip. No breakup, wall film, chemistry, pressure or efficiency prediction.
